caption: The drawing features a pattern set on a brown background. At the top, there is a yellowish curtain swag with irregular dark green streaks and a red border along the bottom edge. In the center top, a yellow tassel with red string is depicted. Vertically, three sets of leafy vines and branch patterns are arranged across the surface: two columns of green leafy branches with small offshoots and dots, and three columns of symmetrical stylized leaves that are dark green with a red accent and a dashed line down the center. The overall composition consists of repeating natural motifs placed in vertical alignment, with the curtain element forming a horizontal border at the top.
title: Wall Stencil
